name: 타락한 뱀파이어
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset, a SQUARE image containing a perfectly regular 2-by-2 SPRITE SHEET on a genuinely transparent background. EXACTLY FOUR independent full-body depictions of the SAME creature, one entirely inside each quadrant with generous transparent gutters; no overlap. Painterly premium Korean dark fantasy ARPG 2.5D hand-painted concept art, intricate readable armor/fur/fabric, luminous restrained edge light, deep colored shadows, atmospheric bronze/moss palette, crisp silhouette and rich material detail. Orthographic 3/4 view facing screen-right with feet visible, camera looking slightly down. All four poses must preserve the EXACT SAME body size, face, costume, limb lengths and camera angle; head and feet occupy matching local baselines. Top-left calm battle-ready idle, top-right attack anticipation, bottom-left controlled attack strike, bottom-right forward walking stride. Keep weapons at shoulder height or lower and inside their own quadrant. Completely transparent negative space, no cast ground shadow, no floor, no labels, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no boxes or separators, no background glow cloud. Creature should fill about 78% of each quadrant height. Highest quality painted detail, no photorealism, no plastic toy/chibi, no blurry silhouettes. Subject: an elegant corrupted vampire aristocrat duelist, pale adult face with visible fangs, long silver hair, burgundy silk and black leather coat, ornate antique gold clasps, crimson curved dagger held below shoulder, ruined cape with subtle blood-red magical veins.
edit_prompt: Edit this supplied sprite sheet while preserving the exact same creature design, painted detail, costume, colors and four poses. Production correction: each full creature AND its entire weapon must fit fully inside its own quadrant of a SQUARE 2x2 sheet. Shrink all four complete characters equally so each uses only 65% of its quadrant height and width, and center each in its own quadrant, with matching foot baseline and equal body size. Add LARGE completely transparent gutters around each pose, at least 60 pixels away from the central vertical and horizontal division at 1024 resolution. NOTHING may touch the outer image edge or cross between quadrants. Shorten or lower bow/hammer/dagger if needed to keep it contained, preserving identity. Top-left idle, top-right anticipation, bottom-left attack, bottom-right walk. No background, no labels, no border, no shadow. Do not add a fifth character. Preserve genuine alpha transparency. Highest quality painterly game-ready detail.
